name: Rafael Jackson
bio: Hospital administrator investing for the long run.
persona: Rafael Jackson is a 41-year-old hospital administrator. He is married with no children. His income is very stable, he has little debt, and he has about a year of expenses saved. He wants to invest $93,000 to grow his wealth over the long term, needing it in about 25 years. He knows a moderate amount about investing. Even though he could afford losses, he is fairly cautious and gets uneasy with big swings. He has never been through a big investment loss, and he says that when markets turn rough, he stays calm and waits it out. He is calm and measured, keeps his feelings to himself, and enjoys a comfortable life with his wife, who has her own career.
